method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates six HackingFinished images in descending name order 05 through 00. The first five are cyan; all use the literal source asset/material/shader settings, with the last using a different material. No hack completion event, progress update or cleanup is implemented in this body. Exact child order: HackingFinished05, HackingFinished04, HackingFinished03, HackingFinished02, HackingFinished01, HackingFinished00. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding. Base/child lifetime, model/event/animation delivery and native asset behavior remain external unless a reused exact provider contract explicitly supplies the bounded fact.
